description: Search the model register: open-weight AI model releases with exact parameter counts, architectural context length, licence and release date. Use this to answer questions about which models exist, how big they are, what they are licensed under, or what shipped recently.

image_input.description: Only models that accept image input

include_derivatives.description: Include quantisations and conversions of other releases (GGUF, MLX, AWQ and similar). Default false.

min_context.description: Minimum architectural context length in tokens

query.description: Substring match on the model id

reasoning.description: Only models whose chat template shows reasoning/thinking support

tool_calling.description: Only models whose chat template shows tool-calling support

name: search_models
